name: Homa Brown Bread
ingredients_raw: WHOLE WHEAT FLOUR - ATTA (52%), REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), PURIFIED WATER,SUGAR, WHEAT BRAN, YEAST, IODISED SALT, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM & SOYABEAN OIL), SOYA FLOUR, VITAL GLUTEN, MILK SOLIDS, PRESERVATIVE (282), FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT (516 & 510), EMULSIFIER (472e), STABILIZERS [170(1), 412], ACIDITY REGULATOR (260), IMPROVERS [1101(1), 1102, 1104] AND ANTIOXIDANT (300), CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (150a)
